predictions.statement: Tiger adapted PLUS and adapted MOOR may remain non-discriminating because their accepted noisy-arm policies were constant action 10.
predictions.interpretation_rule: A zero or small information loss from a constant policy is not evidence of robust state inference.

predictions.statement: Fox × Allee × sigma 0.2 is the intended ecological-method activity check; accepted adapted PLUS and MOOR are decision-active with positive fixed-action headroom.
predictions.interpretation_rule: Ecological state-information comparisons require renewed activity and adaptive headroom in the registered arms.

predictions.statement: RefPlan-inspired is the decisive control for whether its partial observation-likelihood and history-conditioned public representation is sufficient.
predictions.interpretation_rule: RefPlan must not be grouped mechanically with the other general methods.

predictions.statement: Stronger paired raw loss for OGSRL-inspired and BA-MCTS-inspired than for RefPlan-inspired would support the importance of observation-aware preprocessing, but would not by itself establish the need for a new architecture.
predictions.interpretation_rule: Model fitting, posterior sharpness, safety calibration, reward approximation, and planner differences remain bundled.

predictions.statement: If RefPlan-inspired degrades similarly to the other general methods while decision-active ecological methods remain robust, a calibrated recursive latent-state representation becomes a stronger candidate mechanism.
predictions.interpretation_rule: This motivates, but does not causally prove, a latent-state architecture.

predictions.statement: Poor performance under true-state Arm T redirects interpretation toward transition-model fit, reward surrogate, planning, safety formulation, or policy limitations rather than state information.
predictions.interpretation_rule: Do not attribute poor true-state performance to hidden-state uncertainty.

predictions.statement: Any non-identical fitted-artifact hash or residual_sigma value between arms restricts the result to an end-to-end method-bundle interpretation.
predictions.interpretation_rule: Apply label MODEL-FIT AXIS CHANGED — END-TO-END BUNDLE ONLY; no small-change exception.

predictions.statement: No causal state-representation claim is available from this pilot.
predictions.interpretation_rule: A causal mechanism claim requires a separately registered matched-fit experiment outside this pilot.

tiered_outcomes.ecological_state_belief_advantage: Cannot be established from sigma 0.2 screening alone; it additionally requires decision-active ecological methods and confirmation at sigma 0.1 under a separately authorized Stage C.
tiered_outcomes.refplan_sufficient: RefPlan robustness comparable to active ecological methods and better than OGSRL/BA-MCTS/EVD would suggest its model-identity likelihood plus public history captures much of the gap.
tiered_outcomes.broader_belief_limitation: Active ecological robustness with similar degradation across RefPlan and other general methods would motivate calibrated recursive latent-abundance belief.
tiered_outcomes.non_state_limitation: Poor Arm T performance points to transition, reward, planner, support, safety, or policy limitations.
tiered_outcomes.non_discriminating: Constant actions, absent headroom, saturation, parity failure, leakage, uncontrolled component changes, or a zero-noise likelihood route prevent a state-representation conclusion.

reporting_constraints: paired raw loss is primary within method and cell
do not pool, average, or quantitatively rank fox and tiger losses
cross-cell synthesis is limited to sign, within-cell ordering, activity classification, and interpretation category
EVD is reported separately because its raw logged-reward objective is unmatched to the other five
sigma 0.2 is screening only and Stage C is absent
